## 2. OTHER FEES

Where students are not paying a consolidated programme fee as prescribed in section 1, fees shall be payable as follows:

(£)

| Registration: Go Higher (means tested benefits)    | 50                                  |
|----------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------|
| Registration: Submission Pending                   | 200 (50 per quarter)                |
| Examination: Higher Doctorate                      | 710                                 |
| Re-examination: MD                                 | 485                                 |
| Re-examination: PhD                                | 485                                 |
| Re-examination: MPhil                              | 390                                 |
| Re-examination: Dissertation                       | 185                                 |
| Re-examination in session: taught programmes       | Nil                                 |
| Repeat study: with attendance                      | Pro rata to full-time programme fee |
| Repeat study: with partial remote supervision      | 1/3 of module credit value          |
| Repeat study: without attendance                   | 175                                 |

## 3. RESEARCH SUPPORT FEES

Fees payable for consumables for students on MPhil and PhD programmes will be specified within individual applicants' offer letters.  Research support fees shall be payable for specified programmes as follows:

(£)

| Doctor of Dental Science (Orthodontics)             | 3,854 (14,099  for overseas students)    |
|-----------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------|
| Doctor of Dental Science (Endodontics)              | 13,556 (20,940 for overseas students)    |
| Doctor of Dental Science (Special Care Dentistry)   | 3,244 (14,099 for overseas students)     |
| MRes Biomedical Sciences and Translational Medicine | 3,000                                    |
| MRes Clinical Science                               | 3,000                                    |
| Dip Bovine Reproduction                             | 1,195                                    |
